name: step-rail
description: One Career Map route as a vertical list: the roles in order, each a ring on a rail drawn in the route's role colour. Read-only, or selectable rows.

gaps.rows: 0 (rows touch; the Item padding spaces them)

properties.value: An ordered list (ol / li): order is meaning. Give the list an aria-label naming the route ("Roles on Engineering growth").
The rail and rings are aria-hidden; the status text says the state ("You are here", "Active target"), so colour and ring style are never the only signal.
Selectable rows are Item buttons: Tab reaches each, Enter or Space selects; the selected row has aria-current. Read-only rows aren't focusable.
Status text uses career-map text tokens checked on white (current-label 4.8:1 on band-current, target-label AA).
Selectable rows are full-width Items (≥ 24px tall at size sm, WCAG 2.2 AA).

constraints: Use for one route of a Career Map shown as a list: a route panel, a list view card, or the preview of a move (Explore a position).
Set tone from the route's role (the path the employee follows, another company path, a Career vision), never to tell paths apart.
Put the card a route starts from first, muted and without onSelect (context only).
Say the state in words in status; the marker only repeats it visually.
Keep it read-only or single-select; for editing and ordering a path use career-path-stepper.

doNot.wrong: A different colour per company path
doNot.correct: Tone by role: followed (green), other (grey), vision (dashed violet); a legend or heading names the path

doNot.wrong: Numbers, drag handles or edit actions on rows
Rely on the ring colour to say You are here or Active target
doNot.correct: Always pass status text; the ring repeats it
Leave onSelect off it and mark it muted

composition.structure: StepRail ol > StepRailItem li > [rail segment] + Item (icon slot: ring · title: role + status)

behavior.interactionModel: stateless (selection is controlled by the consumer via selected + onSelect)

subComponents.name: step-rail-item
subComponents.role: One role on the route: ring, rail segment and title
subComponents.overrideRule: Use props (marker, statusTone, muted); don't restyle the ring or rail

relatedComponents.name: career-map
relatedComponents.reason: Same family and tokens: the Career Map draws routes as lines between cards; Step Rail shows one route as a list.

relatedComponents.name: career-path-stepper
relatedComponents.reason: Career Path Stepper is the admin editor of a path (numbers, actions, reordering); Step Rail is the employee's read-only view of a route.

relatedComponents.name: item
relatedComponents.reason: Each row is an Item (size sm, type icon); Item alone has no rail.

openQuestions: Not used by any screen yet: CareerMapList rows, the route panel (RouteSteps) and the Explore preview (RoutePreview) still draw their own rails; replacing them is a separate decision.
notes: Part of the Career Map family: it uses career-map/* tokens by design (their Use when names StepRail, 2026-09-28).
Geometry is tied to Item size sm (padding spacing/component/sm, a 1rem icon slot): changing Item sm padding moves the rail.

changelog.change: Created Step Rail (StepRail + StepRailItem) from the rails in CareerMapList and the Explore preview, as one shared component. Career-map token descriptions extended to name it. Not wired into screens yet.

notes: StepRail extends native ol attributes and requires aria-label; StepRailItem extends li attributes.

docs.intro:
# Step Rail

One Career Map route as a vertical list: the roles in order, each a ring on a rail drawn in the route's role colour. Read-only, or selectable rows.

---

sections.title: Structure
sections.body:
```
StepRail — ol, vertical list; tone sets the rail colour (vision = dashed)
└─ StepRailItem ×n — li, relative
   ├─ rail segment — absolute, 2px left border in the tone colour, ring centre → next ring centre (hidden on the last row)
   └─ Item (type icon, size sm; a button when onSelect is set)
      ├─ icon slot 1rem — the ring (0.75rem, 2px border, radius/pill), marker = route | muted | current | target
      └─ title — the role + optional " · status" (statusTone neutral | current | target)
```

---

sections.title: Token Bindings
sections.body:
| Frame | Property | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Rail — tone followed | Line (2px, solid) | `career-map/followed-edge` |
| Rail — tone other | Line (2px, solid) | `career-map/other-path-edge` |
| Rail — tone vision | Line (2px, dashed) | `career-map/vision-edge` |
| Rail | Position | from the ring's centre to the next ring's centre: top = spacing/component/sm + half the icon slot, bottom = the same, negative; none on the last row |
| Ring | Size / border / radius | 0.75rem · 2px · radius/pill |
| Ring — route | Fill / border | career-map/node-surface · the rail's tone token |
| Ring — muted | Fill / border | career-map/node-surface · career-map/node-border |
| Ring — current | Fill / border | career-map/band-current · career-map/current-label |
| Ring — target | Fill / border | career-map/band-target · career-map/target-border |
| Row | Padding / gap | spacing/component/sm (Item size sm) |
| Row | Hover / selected / focus | Item tokens (item/selected/*, color/border/focus) |
| Title | Text | Item title (color/surface/default/foreground, medium) |
| Title — muted | Text | career-map/node-description, regular |
| Status — neutral | Text | career-map/node-description, regular |
| Status — current | Text | career-map/current-label, regular |
| Status — target | Text | career-map/target-label, regular |

---

sections.title: Behavior
sections.body:
- **Read-only by default.** Rows are plain Items; nothing is focusable.
- **Selectable** when a row gets `onSelect`: the row becomes an Item button (hover, focus ring, selected fill and `aria-current`). Leave `onSelect` off the context row (the card a route starts from) so it's never shown selected.
- **Line style follows the tone:** `vision` is dashed, company paths are solid. There is no per-path colour: the tone says the route's role (the path you follow, another company path, a Career vision).
- **Markers say where the employee is:** `current` (You are here), `target` (Active target), `muted` (a role behind you, the start row, a role already on the map), `route` (everything else: a ring in the route's colour).
- **Wrapping:** long titles wrap; the rail is drawn per row from ring to ring, so it stays joined.
- **Not for editing.** No numbers, drag handles or actions: ordering an admin path is `career-path-stepper`.

---
